description: FIDO/U2F authentication using YubiKey hardware security key. Provides strong second factor for MFA. Supporting for OTP codes use of Android applications like Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator, Aegis or Android Authenticator with authentication codes (6-8 digits).

parameters.nouserok: Continue auth if user has no U2F key

parameter_help.authfile: Path to file containing user->key mappings. Can be per-user (~/.config/Yubico/u2f_keys) or central (/etc/u2f_mappings)
parameter_help.nouserok: Allows users without U2F keys to still authenticate (graceful degradation)
parameter_help.openasuser: Allows reading user-specific key files with proper permissions

pam_stack_examples: auth required pam_u2f.so (per-user keys, basic setup)
hardware_requirement: YubiKey 5 Series or compatible FIDO/U2F device
notes: Strong second factor authentication. Requires user to have YubiKey registered. Different deployment models: per-user (01) vs central (02) vs emergency (03).
